caption: I'm Mario, I'm 13. I'm Rishith, I'm 14. I'm Aarav, I'm 16. Investors check pitch claims by hand, days late. We built Proven.
Ask AI search one question and you get one good answer. Diligence is a hundred questions. Proven runs the whole job.
This is Proven. Ask about any company. It searches, reads the pages, and writes a memo while you watch.
Run everything does it in one click: a pitch audit, a full memo, and a watch that re-checks the company.
Pitch Audit on rippling.com: 8 claims in 21 seconds. 4 hold up, 2 are contradicted, 2 are unclear. Trust score 63.
The Builder.ai memo. Verdict: Pass, 95% confidence. 19 of 19 lines verified. 3 high-severity contradictions.
It gave lenders a 2024 sales forecast of about $220M. An audit put sales at about $50M. Hover a line for the quote.
Plan. Route through Telem and Tavily. Research until proven. Write. Find each quote in code. No quote, no line.
Today Telem routed over 230 questions across 16 engines. Two thirds of our verified proof came from engines Telem chose.
An engine earns credit only when its page backs a verified line. Proven learns only from what it could prove.
For investors and buyers. Know what is true before you commit. Built by Rishith, Aarav and Mario. proven-tan.vercel.app
